poses.pose: standing relaxed with a friendly face, arms hanging loosely at the sides
talking, one open palm raised to the side at chest height as if presenting something, the other arm relaxed

poses.what: index finger up, making a point
poses.pose: one index finger raised beside the head, making a point, eyebrows up, the other hand on the hip

poses.what: points off to the side at head height
poses.pose: one arm stretched out to the side pointing at something at head height, looking toward it, the other arm relaxed
pointing straight at the viewer with one index finger, a knowing grin, the other hand on the hip
one hand raised with two fingers held up, the other hand's index finger touching them, counting, eyes up in thought
shoulders raised in a shrug, both palms turned up at waist height, eyebrows raised, a lopsided half smile
one hand on the chin, eyes looking up and to the side, thinking, the other arm across the body supporting the elbow

poses.what: skeptical, one brow up, arms crossed
poses.pose: arms crossed, head tilted, one eyebrow raised high, a doubtful flat mouth
hands on hips, chin raised, half-closed knowing eyes and a sly smile

poses.what: shocked, hands up by the face
poses.pose: shocked: eyes wide, mouth wide open, both hands raised beside the face, the body leaning back a little
surprised: eyebrows up, a small round open mouth, both hands open in front of the chest
laughing hard, head tilted back, eyes squeezed shut, one hand on the belly
a wide happy smile, both arms opened wide in welcome
winking one eye with a grin, one thumb up toward the viewer
head tilted, puzzled frown, one hand scratching the back of the head
worried: brows knitted, hands clasped together near the chest, shoulders hunched a little
sad: shoulders slumped, head hanging, arms limp at the sides, a downturned mouth

poses.what: awkward, rubbing the back of the head
poses.pose: an awkward smile, one hand rubbing the back of the head, eyes glancing aside
annoyed: flat half-lidded eyes, a frown, arms crossed tightly, one foot tapping
angry: fists clenched at the sides, leaning forward, a fierce scowl
determined: one fist raised in front of the chest, a firm set mouth, feet planted wide
excited: both fists pumped up at shoulder height, beaming with sparkling eyes
scared: cowering with knees bent, both hands up near the face, eyes wide
disgusted: leaning away, tongue out, one hand pushing something away
bored: slouching, half-closed eyes, arms dangling
yawning with the eyes closed, one hand over the mouth, the other arm stretched up
a relieved sigh, eyes closed, one hand on the chest
leaning forward with one hand cupped beside the mouth, telling a secret, eyes darting sideways
one hand covering the face, head bowed, the other arm hanging
one arm thrust forward with the palm out, meaning stop, a serious face
wagging one index finger, the other hand on the hip, shaking the head no

poses.what: forearms crossed in an X: not allowed
poses.pose: both forearms crossed in a big X in front of the chest, meaning not allowed, a stern face
a confident stand, hands on hips, chin up, a small proud smile
leaning toward the viewer with hands on the knees, curious wide eyes
palms pressed together in front of the chest, pleading or thankful

poses.what: holds something small and unseen in both hands
poses.pose: both hands cupped together in front of the chest as if holding something small, the hands empty, looking down at them
both arms out pushing hard against something unseen, leaning into it, straining

poses.what: arms out as if carrying a box
poses.pose: both arms held out at chest height as if carrying a box, the hands empty, slightly bent back under the weight
holding a phone in both hands, looking down at its screen

poses.what: shows a phone screen to the viewer
poses.pose: holding a phone out with its screen turned toward the viewer, the other hand pointing at the screen
looking up in wonder, mouth open, arms at the sides

poses.what: leans in and squints at something
poses.pose: leaning forward, squinting closely at something low in front, one hand on the knee

poses.what: shields its eyes from a glare
poses.pose: leaning back with one arm raised shielding squinting eyes from a bright glare
jerking back startled, both hands pulled back and up, eyes wide
both arms thrown up in triumph, a huge open grin

poses.what: walks to the right: the stride (first of the two walk drawings)
poses.pose: walking to the right at full stride, legs apart with the front heel touching down, arms swinging opposite the legs

poses.what: walks to the right: the passing step (second walk drawing, for Walker)
poses.pose: walking to the right at the passing step, standing tall on one straight leg while the other foot lifts past it, arms near the sides
running to the right, leaning forward, one knee high, arms pumping
sitting cross-legged on the ground, hands resting on the knees
standing seen from behind, looking ahead
crouching low with knees bent and arms pulled in, about to spring up
the upper body leaning far back, arms drawn back, winding up before a move
midway through turning from the side to the front, one foot stepping round, arms loose
